integrity: Finite exhaustive certificate justified by the seven-support truncated-multiplicity reduction; independent microscopic simulations are supplementary rather than infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The exact basin and primitive-orbit polynomials are for three shores, whereas the iterate identity holds for any number at least three. No individual three-cycle basin law or extension to other color counts is claimed. Novelty against inaccessible or unindexed earlier sources cannot be ruled out.
title: A tripartite period collapse and exact basins in three-color cyclic automata
